service_name.description: Name of the GSSAPI service (e.g., 'krb5') used as identifier and in log messages.

server_principal.description: The Kerberos service principal name (SPN) the daemon will accept — must match a keytab entry.

socket_path.description: Unix domain socket path where gssproxy listens for client connections.

keytab.description: Path to the Kerberos keytab file containing the service credentials.

mechanism.description: GSSAPI mechanism OID (or alias like 'kerberos') — typically '1.2.840.113554.1.2.2' for Kerberos.

cred_store.description: Credential cache storage method (e.g., 'FILE', 'MEMORY') with optional path templating (e.g., 'FILE:/tmp/gssproxy_%u').

allow_root.description: If true, allows root user to access this GSSAPI service (default: false).

allowed_euids.description: List of numeric effective user IDs (eUIDs) permitted to use this service.

allowed_gids.description: List of numeric group IDs (GIDs) permitted to use this service.

debug.description: If true, enables verbose debugging output to syslog (default: false).

extra_services.description: Additional GSSAPI service definitions beyond the primary 'krb5' service.

server_principal.description: Service principal name (SPN) for this service.

socket_path.description: Unix socket path for this service (optional).

keytab.description: Keytab file path (optional; defaults to global keytab).

cred_store.description: Credential store method (e.g., 'MEMORY' for ephemeral caches).

allow_root.description: Allow root access for this service?

debug.description: Enable debug logging for this service?

hostname.description: System hostname used to construct default server_principal (e.g., 'host/myhost.example.com').

realm.description: Kerberos realm name used in default server_principal.
